n7cc16a5a71.headline: Can manufacturers warn that demand for tinplate will continue to fall
n7cc16a5a71.summary: Manufacturers warn that demand for tinplate will keep declining due to migration from steel to aluminum, causing stoppages at Arcelor's Avilés factory in Spain.
n7cc16a5a71.why: Material demand shifts affect steel producers and related industries, influencing supply chains and regional industrial activity.
